cinnamon roll noun

also cinnamon bun, cinnamon swirl, sweet roll

classical

Cato, Agr. 77
M-O s.v. pastry types: cinnamon roll

spīra, spīrae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

a coiled cake

Cato’s coil-cake: the dough of a placenta, rolled out like a rope and coiled, then spread with honey. Morgan–Owens gives spīra ex cinnamōmō where the cinnamon matters.

Other words

  • pāniculus cinnamōmeus — cinnamon roll

    also used · modern · Andresian p. 10

    Traupman’s pāniculus, a bread roll, with an adjective on cinnamōmum that is not in Lewis & Short (which has cinnameus and cinnamōminus).

Examples

  • spīram sīc facitō … ita utī placenta fit, eadem omnia facitō, nisi aliō modō fingitō

    make a coil-cake like this: … do everything as for a placenta, only shape it differentlyCato, Agr. 77

See also cinnamon, bread roll, pastry, cake.

SourcesLewis & Short: spira · Lewis & Short: cinnamomum
